description: Clean counterpart to perf-nplus1-loop: a pool with connect, statement and query timeouts, one batched ANY($1) query released in finally, an LRU-bounded cache, a fetch with AbortSignal.timeout, and a heartbeat that skips a tick while the previous ping is in flight and whose stop function clears it

_calibration.note: Clean fixture: any finding is a false positive, and a pass status means zero issues per the output contract.
